IQF Frozen Strawberries

Tufan Organik IQF Frozen Strawberries belongs to the Frozen Fruits range. It is a natural food with roots in Gürün/Sivas; contact us for product, packaging and order details.

فراولة مجمدة فردياً (IQF)

IQF-tiefgefrorene Erdbeeren
